# Queued template cancellation across encoded Load

2026-10-03. Diagnostic only; no production/persistence/UI/copy change. Own isolated branch `codex/template-post-demolition-history-audit-20261003`, based on the published minimap evidence tail (gameplay remains the exact root #2018 build source). No browser/server was launched.

## Actual packed-kernel result

Place a genuine Basic Cell at (10,10), quarterTurns1, normal or mirrored. Dispatch and execute one kernel tick: its shell orders are `materials-pending`, current cancellation revision2. Submit the real packed `CancelBuildOrder` with that token at tick13, using the existing public `CANCEL_BUILD_ORDER_LEAD_TICKS=12`. Capture at tick1, before delivery arrival or a state transition. Encode/decode the full real V8 envelope, including that one queued command, and restore the actual runtime.

The restored queued command is byte-equivalent and the actual order data equal. The restored counter is0. Advance both real kernels to the same scheduled command tick:

| q1 Cell | Live | Encoded V8 Load |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Expected token | 2 | 2 |
| Restored counter before replay | n/a | 0 |
| Selected order after replay | cancelled | materials-pending |
| Pending templates | 0 | 1 |
| Funds at Save | 23,575 | 23,575 |
| Funds after replay | 25,000 | 23,575 |
| Refusal | none | cancel-build-order.stale-cancellation |

The normal/mirrored cases agree. Initial [four-case baseline](./raw/queued-cancel-baseline.txt): 2 RED/2 legal fresh post-Load token controls. [Measured six-case run](./raw/queued-cancel-measured.txt): 2 RED/4 legal, adding genuine live stale-token refusal without funds/order/template mutation. Strict application types pass. Only commands, kernel ticks and real encoded persistence APIs construct this fixture; no world seed/state injection, synthetic verdict, renderer feed, or private worker replacement.

The measurement uses the same production cancellation lead constant, not a browser claim. Native click-to-Save scheduling has not been exercised. Queued commands are explicitly part of the genuine snapshot and worker restoration contract; a command already dispatched before Save is a different legal case.

## Exact source and existing rules

`ConstructionSystem.orderRevisions` is intentionally ephemeral; `snapshot/restore` persist orders and history but not this Map. `revisionOf` consequently returns0 after restoration. The unchanged queued packed command still carries2, so the existing handler correctly applies its local mismatch guard, but to a lost counter.

ADR0107 Decision§2 argues that the main-thread row cannot survive Load. That remains true, and the fresh post-Load row controls pass. The omitted boundary is the command already accepted into the persisted kernel queue. Decision§6 explicitly requires an owner decision if a reason is found to persist the counter. This diagnostic does not silently normalize queued tokens, infer counters from state/order sequence, weaken the stale guard, or extend the save schema.

Fresh searches for queued cancellation, expectedRevision and orderRevisions found no matching Issue. Closed #853 is the historical live row/refund race which introduced the stale-cancellation rule; its full body was read. #1985 concerns the separate newer-action Undo flag, #1996 concerns refused-command history marking, #1669 concerns immediate pending-template reconciliation after a valid cancellation. None preserves this accepted queued cancellation token across Load.

## Concrete reserved review proposal — NOT implemented

Recommended: after explicit owner approval, persist the exact existing per-order counters as an optional construction snapshot map, with a data-preserving next-version migration and frozen historical validators. Capture/restore those raw exact counters alongside the unchanged queued command payloads. Keep absent historical counters on their existing default0/safe stale-refusal path; do not guess them from state or sequence. Preserve current stale refusal text, live state-transition detection, tariff/refund semantics and all old order/history/command data. The exact next schema version/field shape must be coordinated with root's separate #1985 proposal rather than allocated by this agent.

The alternative is to defer the field and retain the measured safe refusal and pending plan. Silently rebasing all queued tokens to0 would permit genuinely stale requests, and an ordinal derived from lifecycle state cannot represent repeated Undo/Redo cycles. Neither is an acceptable unapproved shortcut.

This branch currently contains the reproducing RED tests and no production fix. It must not be imported as an asserted GREEN release checkpoint. No producer-negative or native acceptance is claimed while the field decision is pending.
title: Save/Load loses cancellation revision for an already queued room-template command
